jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About the role At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own in our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision , using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams. What you'll be up to Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities . Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope , with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. What you'll bring 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. Strongly preferred Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. Nice to have Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. Who you are You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. Joining Apaleo How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager - Stage de fin d'études Paris - Theodo AI-Mod
jobs.description: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! Ton équipe : Tu intègres une équipe projet composée de développeurs, de designers et d'un Lead Product Manager. Leur rôle : concevoir des produits de qualité, les livrer dans les temps, avec un excellent niveau de service. Ton objectif en tant qu'Associate Product Manager est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité à ton client. Tes futures missions : - Piloter le delivery en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : prioriser les features, rédiger des user stories claires et s’assurer de respecter les jalons pour délivrer dans les temps. - Collaborer avec ton client pour comprendre ses besoins, challenger ses idées et co-construire des solutions digitales à forte valeur ajoutée. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Chez Theodo, on recherche des personnes qui ont envie d’apprendre et de progresser. Plusieurs career paths sont possibles au sein de ton entité ou du groupe. En fonction de tes appétences, tu pourras évoluer vers différents rôles (Product Manager, Lead Product Manager…). Profil recherché : - Tu es diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieur - Tu souhaites participer à la conception de produits à fort impact business - Tu as un excellent relationnel et sera à l’aise en face de nos clients - Tu es passionné par la tech, et tu as de bonnes connaissances sur ce sujet - Tu as une énorme envie d’apprendre, de challenger et d’être challengé(e) pour progresser Process de recrutement : - 1er appel avec un recruteur (30min) - Entretien Fit Culturel (1h) - Entretien tech & produit (1h) - Entretien dirigeant (30min) Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne . Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🚇 Remboursement de 50% de l'abonnement de transport ou mobilité durable 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ? jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Team
jobs.description: About us Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the role As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service. What you’ll do: Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product. Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions. Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day. Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly. Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call. Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on. What you'll need: 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches. You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams. Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits. A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products. You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes. This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Generous start-up equity Competitive Salary Lunch provided in the office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How We Use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
